known_traps: A Windows-created linked worktree may be valid to Windows Git but is not a safe Linux Git checkout. Create a WSL-owned standalone exact-head clone.
Do not inherit the default WSL distribution. Select contract-defined Ubuntu explicitly for every bridge process.
PowerShell CRLF transported into bash -lc can break set -euo pipefail. Normalize every transported command to LF first.
Native stdout or stderr may be empty. PowerShell helpers must accept empty strings and preserve the process exit code as authority.
Capture stdout and stderr separately. WSL configuration warnings on stderr are diagnostics, not machine-readable stdout.
Do not depend on wslpath for Windows path transport. Use WSLENV /p for reviewed path variables.
Every WSL process needs a bounded timeout. Timeout exit 124 is a failure, never readiness evidence.
Contract or hosted Windows PASS does not prove the physical Ubuntu/WSL floor.
The prerequisite gate may report apt/gh recovery commands but must not install dependencies or mutate credentials itself.
Do not revive the historical AgentSwitchboard FirstMate route selector or crew-orchestration skill; live dispatch and lifecycle belong to FirstMate.
